newsitem.title: FRANCE: LEP upgrades France-Canada consolidation service.
newsitem.headline: LEP upgrades France-Canada consolidation service.

text.p: The French arm of forwarding group, LEP International, has upgraded its airfreight activities between France and Canada.

"Earlier this month, due to a growing volume of traffic, we began operating a daily consolidation service between Paris/CDG and Montreal having previously shipped goods on the route to a three times weekly frequency," a LEP France official told Reuters.
The official said the upgrade was a direct response to shippers requirements especially those in the aeronautic industry.
LEP France has a long-standing agreement with Air Canada, which operates daily passenger services on the Paris-Montreal route. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
